create_feedback_endpoint: create a FastAPI endpoint that submits thumbs-up or thumbs-down feedback for a run with an optional comment and message scope
upsert_feedback_endpoint: create or update feedback for a run with an idempotent PUT endpoint that accepts a rating and optional comment
list_feedback_endpoint: list all feedback entries for a specific run in a thread using a GET endpoint
feedback_stats_endpoint: get aggregated feedback statistics including total positive and negative counts for a run
delete_feedback_endpoint: delete a specific feedback record by feedback ID after verifying it belongs to the given thread and run
